sloka: घण्टानामिव सन्नादः शुश्रुवे मधुरस्वरः ।अप्सरोगणसङ्घानां गायतां धनदालये ।। ७.२६.९ ॥
transliteration: ghaṇṭānāmiva sannādaḥ śuśruve madhurasvaraḥ ।apsarogaṇasaṅghānāṁ gāyatāṁ dhanadālaye ।। 7.26.9 ॥

translations.english: In Kubera's abode, a sweet sound was heard, like the ringing of bells, from the singing groups of Apsaras.
